Add 5x volume of buffer PB and proceed to PCR purify via Qiagen PCR purification kit each pool using 1 column per pool, eluting in 100 uL EB per pool. Note that you may want to use tube extenders since there can be a lot of volume to go through one column.

Library amplification Once optimal cycle number is determined, run a 100 µL PCR with the following conditions: Load PCR onto a 2% agarose gel with SYBR (3 large wells, 12 tooth comb, 1.5 mm thickness) and gel purify band around 350-410 bp. There will be a smear in this size range: make to include the entire size range, as pegRNA length varies and we want to include all pegRNAs. Elute in 50 µL EB. Perform PCR purification on this eluted gel purification. Start by mixing 50 µL eluted gel purification product with 250 µL buffer PB and continue with standard Qiagen PCR purification protocol. Elute in 30 µL EB.

steps.title: Prepare ssDNA Oligo Pool Stock
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2 ng/µL stock of the lyophilized ssDNA oligo pool.

substeps.instruction: Spin down the lyophilized ssDNA oligo pool.
Resuspend in TE buffer with low EDTA (10 mM Tris-Cl pH 8.0, 0.1 mM EDTA) to a concentration of 2 ng/µL.
Store the stock at -20°C.

steps.title: Digest pLenti Vector
steps.instruction: Digest the pLenti U6_r2ad_IN-PE2-SSB_PuroR vector using BsmBI-V2.

substeps.instruction: Cut 10 µg of pLenti U6_r2ad_IN-PE2-SSB_PuroR with BsmBI-V2.
Incubate the reaction at 55 °C for 3-4 hours.
Run the digest on a 1% agarose gel with SYBR; distribute 100 µL of the reaction among 3 large agarose gel wells (12 tooth comb, 1.5 mm thickness).
Cut out the band at 16.38 kbp.

steps.title: Amplify Library and Determine PCR Cycles
steps.instruction: Amplify the library and use qPCR to determine the optimal number of PCR cycles.

substeps.instruction: Perform library amplification using primers 010415_sgRNA_60bp_fw (TAACTTGAAAGTATTTCGATTTCTTGGCTTTATATATCT TGTGGAAAGGACGAAACACCG) and 062024_r2seq_i722_BsrGrv (TTTAAAACTTTATCCATCTTTGCATGTACA GAAGACGGCATACGAGAT NN CTGCGC GTGACTGGAGTTC AGACGTGTGCTCTTCCGATCT).
Run a qPCR with 0.5 µL of 100924_fullLDLR_pegRNA_library in 15 µL qPCR mix to determine optimal cycles.
Follow qPCR program: 98 °C for 30 sec, then repeat (98 °C 10 sec, 69 °C 30 sec, 72 °C 60 sec) for 25 cycles, ending with 4 °C for 5 min.
Identify the cycle where log-linear increase stops (typically 4-6 cycles after CT), adjust for input difference between qPCR and PCR, and subtract 5 cycles to determine the final PCR cycle number.

steps.title: Clean up and Concentrate Gibson Reaction
steps.instruction: Purify and concentrate the Gibson reaction product.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL GlycoBlue, 2 µL 50mM NaCl, and 100 µL Isopropanol to 100 µL of Gibson reaction.
Vortex and incubate at room temperature for 15 min.
Spin at >15,000 x g for 15 min.
Carefully remove liquid using P200, P20, or P10 pipettes without disturbing the pellet.
Wash the pellet with 300 µL 80% EtOH and spin at >15,000 x g for 5 min.
Remove most liquid with P1000, spin at >15,000 x g for 1 min, then remove all remaining liquid with P200/P20/P10.
Air-dry the pellet for 3-5 minutes at room temperature with the cap open.
Resuspend the pellet by adding 8.25 µL EB and warming at 55°C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Determine Cloned Library Diversity and Coverage
steps.instruction: Transform a small amount of assembly mix into Endura cells to assess diversity and coverage.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 µL of assembly mix to 25 µL of Lucigen Endura electrocompetent cells (repeat 4x).
Electroporate using a 1mm pre-chilled cuvette: 10 μF, 600 Ohms, 1800 Volts.
Immediately add 1 mL Lucigen recovery media to the cuvette.
Gently pipet the suspension into a 14 mL culture tube containing 1 mL Lucigen recovery media.
Incubate at 30°C for 1 hour while shaking.

steps.title: Verify Cloning via Colony PCR
steps.instruction: Perform colony PCR and sequencing to verify the cloned sgRNAs.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.25 µL of purified assembled mix to 25 µL of NEB Stable cells; incubate 30 minutes on ice.
Heat shock at exactly 42°C for 30 seconds, then ice for 5 minutes.
Add 975 µL NEB 10-beta/Stable Outgrowth Medium and incubate at 30°C for 1 hour while shaking.
Plate 1/10, 1/100, and 1/1,000 dilutions onto LB agar plates (100 µg/mL ampicillin) and incubate at 30°C overnight.
Perform colony PCR on 16 colonies using primers 091324_U6_latefw (ATTTCTTGGGTAGTTTGCAGTTT) and 031621_postSmarv (GCTGCAAAGATTCCTCTCTG).
Load 5 µL of PCR product onto a 2% agarose gel with ethidium bromide; successful cloning shows bands at 400-500 bp (bands >1000 bp indicate plasmid background; re-clone if >2 colonies show this).
Purify the remaining colony PCR via QIAquick PCR Purification Kit and perform Sanger sequencing with primer 091324_U6_latefw.

steps.title: Scale Up Library Production
steps.instruction: Pool electroporation mixes and expand the library in LB medium.

substeps.instruction: Pool all 4 electroporation mixes in a 50 mL centrifugation tube and mix by swirling.
Take 10 µL of the pool, add to 1 mL recovery medium, and plate 20 µL and 100 µL dilutions onto pre-warmed LB agar plates (100 µg/mL ampicillin) to determine coverage.
Transfer the pooled mix into 400 mL LB medium (100 µg/mL ampicillin) and incubate at 30°C overnight while shaking.
Centrifuge the suspension as 2x200 mL aliquots (3000 x g, 4°C, 20 minutes).
Maxi prep one pellet and store the other at -20°C as backup.

steps.title: Produce Lentiviral Plasmid Library
steps.instruction: Transfect HEK293FT cells to produce the lentiviral library.

substeps.instruction: Day -1: Plate 4x15 cm plates with HEK293FT cells at 1.625 x 10^7 cells per plate in 20 mL DMEM + 10% FBS.

Day 0: At 50-60% confluence, replace media with 16 mL DMEM + FBS. Prepare Tube A (4 mL OptiMEM, 9.7 µg pMDLg/pRRE, 6.5 µg pRSV-Rev, 3.3 µg pcDNA3-VSV-G, 13 µg Lentiviral Plasmid Library) and Tube B (4 mL OptiMEM, 98 µl TransIT-Lenti Reagent). Mix B into A, invert, and incubate for 15 min at room temperature.
Day 1: Collect lentiviral supernatant (store at 4°C) and replace medium with 16 mL DMEM+10% FBS.
Day 2: Collect lentiviral supernatant (store at 4°C) and replace medium with 16 mL DMEM+10% FBS.
Day 3: Collect and pool all lentiviral supernatants.

steps.title: Concentrate and Titrate Lentivirus
steps.instruction: Concentrate the pooled lentivirus and determine the appropriate dose for infection.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge pooled supernatant at 1,500 x g for 45 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend pellet in 2 mL DMEM+10% FBS per 15 cm plate; aliquot 500 µL per cryovial (-80°C) and save two 60 µL aliquots for titration.
Alternatively, centrifuge pooled supernatant at 300 x g for 5 minutes, filter through 0.45 µm, add 1/3 volume Lenti-X Concentrator, and incubate 30 min or overnight at 4°C.
Titrate on a 24-well plate (5.2 x 10^4 cells/well) using dilutions (1/150 to 1/4800) to find the dose resulting in 50% survival.

steps.title: Infect and Select HCT116 Cells
steps.instruction: Infect HCT116 cells with the lentiviral library and select with puromycin.

substeps.instruction: Day 0: Add 3.91 x 10^6 HCT cells to a 15 mL tube, add the calculated lentivirus dose, and plate onto 15 cm dishes (20 mL medium with 8 µg/mL polybrene) in 4 replicates. Seed 266,000 cells in a 6-well as a selection control.
Day 3: Replace medium with 20 µL (likely 20 mL) of McCoy+10% FBS containing 500 ng/mL puromycin.
Day 4: Split cells 1:2 into new 15 cm dishes with 20 mL McCoy+10% FBS and 500 ng/mL puromycin.
Day 6: Split cells 1:2 into two new 15 cm dishes with 20 mL McCoy+10% FBS and 500 ng/mL puromycin.

steps.title: Perform LDL Uptake Screen
steps.instruction: Screen cells for LDL uptake using BODIPY FL LDL and FACS sorting.

substeps.instruction: Day 8: Seed 31.25 x 10^6 cells per replicate in 15 cm dishes (or 12.25 x 10^6 in 10 cm dishes) in McCoy+10% FBS.
Day 9: Change medium to OptiMEM in the late afternoon for serum starvation.
Day 10: 4-6 hours before FACS, replace medium with 16 mL OptiMEM containing 40 µL BODIPY FL LDL.
Harvest cells, trypsinize, spin down, and resuspend in DMEM+10% FBS with DAPI.
Sort cells into bins: Bottom 20%, Bottom 20-40%, Top 20-40%, and Top 20%.
Isolate gDNA from sorted and bulk cells using PureLink Genomic DNA Mini Kit, eluting in 100 µL.

steps.title: Prepare Libraries for NGS
steps.instruction: Perform qPCR and PCR to prepare the sorted libraries for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Perform qPCR1 to determine CT values using primers 101317_U6PE1_BcX (ACTCTTTCCCTACACGACGCTCTTCCGATCT NNNNN GGAAAGGACGAAACACCG) and 112822_P7_anchor (CAAG CAGAAGACGGCATACGAGAT).
Pool samples with CT values within 0.5 cycles of each other, ensuring each sample uses a distinct U6PE1 barcoded primer.
Perform PCR2 using 2-3 cycles less than the qPCR CT (minimum 5 cycles). If CT < 7, reduce PCR1 product input (e.g., 6 µL) to allow for 5 cycles.
PCR purify PCR2 products on columns and elute in 50 µl EB buffer.
Analyze products via Tapestation (D1000 screen/ladder/buffer).
Pool samples based on nM concentration from Tapestation using the formula: [(desired read per sample)/(desired total read)]/Tapestation nM * X000.
Perform 0.80X SPRI bead purification (40 µL beads for 50 µL pool) to remove primer dimers; elute in 20 µL EB buffer.

steps.title: Sequence Libraries
steps.instruction: Sequence the prepared libraries to analyze the screen results.

substeps.instruction: Aim for >400 average reads per library member (e.g., >2.5M reads for a 6,000-member library).
Sequencing parameters: Read 1 (150 nt), Read 2 (150 nt), Index 1 (8 nt), Index 2 (8 nt).
